title: Data and appliance-v1 artefacts for: A sub-microsecond relay-BP decoder for the [[144,12,12]] gross code
description: Campaign data behind every table and figure of the preprint (message-width sweep, leg/iteration budget sweep, on-silicon logical-error-rate campaigns, non-convergence/heralding data, ASAP7 timing and power reports) plus the appliance-v1 Kria KV260 bitstream, hardware handoff, driver and golden vectors released at https://github.com/aleph-sim/aleph/releases/tag/appliance-v1. See MANIFEST.txt for a per-file description and SHA256SUMS for integrity.
